newsitem.title: UK: Citicorp says reviewing futures broking.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp says reviewing futures broking.

text.p: International banking group Citicorp said on Friday it is in the process of reviewing its strategy in the futures broking business and "specifically whether it requires its own execution and clearing capabilities."

A Citicorp statement made available to Reuters in London said that Citicorp is currently a member of 17 exchanges, conducting business for both customers and its own account. A spokeswoman for the bank said that London staff concerned in futures trading had been informed before the markets opened on Friday.
The bank said the review was part of the company's "sharpened Capital Markets focus to enable Citicorp to devote resources to its core product strengths."
It said these are derivatives, foreign exchange and fixed income and emerging markets. The spokeswoman declined to comment on whether the review would lead to any job losses.
